answer:
Your records list two active medications:

1. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once a day. This is a cholesterol-lowering statin.

2. Jardiance 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once a day in the morning. This is used for blood sugar control in type 2 diabetes, and it also helps protect the kidneys and heart.

Metformin 500 mg was stopped in April 2024 and is not on your current list. Your records do not say why it was stopped, which is covered in your check-up questions. Your records also do not show when you started either active medication, only the dates the prescriptions were written (20 February 2025). Please check this list with your pharmacy or doctor, since the records may not show every change.
short: Current medications per records: atorvastatin 20 mg once daily and Jardiance 10 mg once daily in the morning. Metformin was stopped April 2024. Start dates are not recorded.
